sections.heading: Who we are
sections.text: This website is operated by The Associates ("we", "us"). For any privacy question, contact us at info@theassociates.me.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.text:
We only collect the personal information you choose to send us through the contact form or by email: your name, email address, phone number, company and the content of your message.

We do not use advertising or analytics cookies, and we do not track you across other websites.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.text: We use your information only to reply to your enquiry, to assess whether we can assist you (including conflict checks), and, if you become a client, to provide our services. We do not sell or rent your information to anyone.

sections.heading: Service providers
sections.text: Contact-form messages are delivered to our mailbox through FormSubmit, an email forwarding service. Our email is hosted by Google Workspace. Website fonts are served by Google Fonts, which receives your IP address when the page loads. These providers process data on our behalf and may be located outside your country.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.text: Enquiries that do not lead to an engagement are deleted within 24 months. Client records are kept for as long as required by applicable professional and legal obligations.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
sections.text: Please do not send confidential or time-sensitive information through this website until we have confirmed in writing that we can act for you.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.text: Subject to the law that applies to you, you may ask us to access, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, or object to its use. Email info@theassociates.me and we will respond within 30 days.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.text: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last changed.

sections.heading: General information only
sections.text: The content of this website is provided for general information only. It does not constitute legal advice and should not be relied on as such. You should obtain specific advice on your own circumstances before acting.

sections.heading: No lawyer–client relationship
sections.text: Using this website, or sending us a message through it, does not create a lawyer–client relationship. That relationship begins only once we have confirmed in writing that we will act for you.

sections.heading: Not a solicitation
sections.text: This website is intended to provide information about The Associates and its lawyers. It is not intended as advertising or solicitation, in accordance with the professional rules that apply to our lawyers, including those of the Beirut Bar Association.

sections.heading: Accuracy and links
sections.text: We take care to keep this website accurate, but laws change and we make no warranty that its content is complete or current. Links to third-party websites are provided for convenience; we are not responsible for their content.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.text: To the fullest extent permitted by law, The Associates accepts no liability for any loss arising from the use of this website or reliance on its content.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.text: The content, logo and design of this website belong to The Associates. They may not be reproduced without our prior written consent.
